_comment: Hand-picked exact Wikimedia Commons files per subject/topic, verified to load. This is the geography-pack method: the human chooses the file, the builder only renders it. Keys are subject slugs; values map a topic (must match data/figure-topics-curated.json) to the exact Commons filename. A topic absent here is simply not shipped (no good Commons diagram exists) rather than filled with a wrong auto-pick.
_comment_stamps: 'Indian classical dance forms' and 'Beti Bachao Beti Padhao' are hand-picked because article-based resolution cannot fix either. The Wikipedia pageimage for 'Indian classical dance' is a Colnect postage stamp, and pickImage prefers the lead image, so the stamp won under every article mapping; for Beti Bachao Beti Padhao the article offers only the logo and a stamp. Commons has no composite diagram of the classical dance forms, so a single Bharatanatyam performance stands in for the set -- partial, but a real dance rather than a stamp. Do not 'fix' these by adding an _entities mapping; that is what produced the stamps.
